title: The Runs page shows the flow runs that actually happen: each flow cycle and the daily digest, counted in the last 24 hours
description: On the Owner's machine the Runs page and flowweb.app/runs say 0 runs and 'No runs started in the last 24 hours' while the neighborhood activation flow ran ten cycles that day, its lead hunt ran inside one, and the daily digest published. The Runs page only reads GET /v1/runs, which lists ledger-row agent runs (work orders); a flow cycle is recorded by fwd as a status report of kind 'run' (body: stream_id, flow, fire_id, adapter, outcome drafted | dry | failed, drafts, hunts, reason) and the digest as a status report of kind 'daily', so neither ever reaches the page. Both are already served by GET /v1/status-reports?kind= and copied to the hosted mirror. The Runs page also reads those two kinds and shows them as flow runs: a 'Flow runs' section listing each one with its flow, what it did (Drafted with the number of drafts, Nothing drafted, Failed with the reason, Published for the digest), leads found by any hunt, the engine, when it started and how long it took. The 'Last 24 hours' panel and the summary count include them, so the page never says no runs happened when flows ran. Agent runs are shown as before. No fwd, schema or mirror change.
acceptance: With no agent runs and three flow reports in the last 24 hours, the Last 24 hours panel counts 3 runs and does not say no runs started
A 'Flow runs' section lists every flow cycle and digest report with Drafted and the number of drafts, Nothing drafted, Failed with its reason, Published, and leads found by a hunt
The summary count includes flow runs
Agent runs from GET /v1/runs still show in the runs table
